summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing notice of its 63rd Annual General Meeting of Shareholders and related information materials. This is a routine proxy circular for an ordinary shareholder meeting, not a special situation. The filing does not announce any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. As a routine meeting notice, it falls outside all special-situations categories.
